Sports · India

England defeats India in T20 series, women's Test also underway

England secured a comprehensive 4-0 series sweep against India in the T20 international series, with a record partnership contributing to India's defeat. Concurrently, a women's Test match between India and England is taking place at Lord's, marking a historic occasion. Following the T20 loss, an Indian player described the team as being in 'transition'.
